summary: This figure explains how QCON's QoE Monitor tracks frame-level transmission status inside the Radio Access Network. A table titled 'Frame Transmission Status' records, per frame ID, the arrival time (when the frame's packets reached the base station from the application server) and departure time (when they left toward the UE), with the earliest not-yet-departed frame highlighted. Below the table, a small relay diagram shows packets for frames Fn+1 and Fn arriving at the base station, which then forwards frames onward through separate 5G and 4G egress links toward the UE's phone icon, with Fn-1's packets shown departing over 4G. Because the base station is the last hop before the UE, it can observe packet arrivals directly, letting QCON reconstruct millisecond-accurate per-frame transmission timelines without relying on coarse metrics like frame rate.
